info.cls_ename: Department of Industrial Engineering and Systems Management
info.sub_name: 工業自動化理論與應用

description.sub_name: 工業自動化理論與應用
description.describe_ch: 本課程介紹工業自動化的基本理論、技術與應用，涵蓋感測器、控制系統、執行元件及工業通訊等技術。學生將學習設計並實現自動化系統的基本能力，結合嵌入式系統與智慧製造的實務案例，理解如何優化工業流程並提升生產效率。
description.describe_eh: This course provides an introduction to the theories, technologies, and applications of industrial automation. Topics include sensors, control systems, actuators, and industrial communication. Students will develop essential skills to design and implement automation systems, incorporating embedded systems and smart manufacturing practices to optimize industrial processes and enhance productivity.
